artifacts.title: Evans v. Arizona Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: TE John Evans appealed Arizona Presbytery's vote to divest him of his office without censure under BCO 34-10, after he had already affiliated with the Evangelical Presbyterian Church in England and Wales and notified the Presbytery of his withdrawal. The SJC unanimously sustained the appeal and reversed the Presbytery's action, holding that Evans had withdrawn from Presbytery's jurisdiction under BCO 38-3a before the divestiture proceedings began, and instructed the Presbytery to record the irregularity, acknowledge his new membership, and remove his name from the roll.
